literal: Those who did harmful deeds by arrogance, oneself, by one's own forbearance, having conquered, should conquer completely.
translation: Conquer with your own forbearance those who, out of arrogance, have done harmful deeds to you.
modern: செருக்கினால் தீமைகளைச் செய்தவர்களை, நாம் நம்முடைய பொறுமையால் வென்றுவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate way to respond to insolence and harm. When people commit wrongful acts against us out of arrogance (மிகுதி), our natural instinct might be to retaliate. However, the poet advises us to conquer them using our own forbearance and dignified conduct (தகுதி). By remaining patient and righteous, we disarm their hostility and achieve a true, noble victory over their bad behavior.
